title: Polish Aircrew 1943 Dunmoor Hill
memorial_details: Blue-painted bronze plaque with a raised white border mounted on a wooden backboard, dedicated to the crew of a Wellington Bomber of 301 Pomeranian Squadron which crashed on Dunmoor Hill on 9th January 1943. The dedication is in raised white Roman capitals on a pecked background. Plaque and backboard are fixed at 45 degrees on top of a 1 metre post, which is supported at the base by a cairn of loose rocks. This death is also recorded on the memorial to WW2 airmen killed on the Cheviot Hills (34297).
inscription: IN MEMORY OF/[names]/9th JANUARY 1943/VICKERS WELLINGTON/R1535 GR-G/301 POMERANIAN SQN.
community_connection: The inscription is for a crash site of an aircraft, indicating the community's connection to those who served in the Pomeranian Squadron.
